carried.grounds: Re-derived at the snapshot (story_runner.py, proof.py, routing.py, outcome.py, format3.py, merge.py are byte-identical to c4c1720, i.e. to the proof's own base). Value flow: story_runner.py:247-248 builds `preserved` (ObligationRole is read at no other line of the module but :139 `o.role.value` from plan.obligations); :250 `spec_id, role = obligations.get(cid) or preserved[cid]` (the plan's own role wins whenever the cid is one of the story's obligations); :251-253 hands `role` to prove() with the literal point MeasurementPoint.CANDIDATE. In prove() (proof.py:80-111) `role` is read once, at :107 `route(bound, spec, point, role)`; prove() refuses PARENT first (:86-87); the Proof (:28-37), the probe/evaluated payloads (plain(record)), the proof/verified payload (format3.verified_payload :233-246) and the gate row (`proof:{cid}`, :255-256) carry no role, and the Party range name is built from `under = criterion/point` (:88, :69). In route/row_for (routing.py:96-130) role has three readers: the isinstance guard (:114-115; all three labels are ObligationRole members), the table lookup (:125-126) and the fail-closed text (:102-103). Every role-keyed row of _EXECUTED is at PARENT (:70, :73, :76); the CANDIDATE rows (:81-86) are keyed role None, so .get((C, sat, reason, label)) misses and the `or` falls to (C, sat, reason, None): the same Route for any label. The fail-closed text is reachable only when row_for returns None; at CANDIDATE it cannot, by totality: Executed.__post_init__ (outcome.py:43-50) allows a reason only on INDETERMINATE and only an IndeterminateReason, which has exactly PRECONDITION_ABSENT and NON_CONTROLLER_SIGNAL (:28-33); contract_satisfaction (:71-79) yields SATISFIED/UNSATISFIED (no reason) or INDETERMINATE; the table has (C,S,None), (C,U,None), (C,I,PA), (C,I,NCS); UNRUNNABLE/INVALID_SPEC return at routing.py:120-123 before the lookup. The only place INTRODUCE differs from PRESERVE in the table is the PARENT PRECONDITION_ABSENT row (:70 READY vs :73 PRECONDITION_BROKEN); PARENT is refused by prove() before any role is read, so that row is unreachable from this call site (story_admission.py:80, the PARENT caller, passes the plan's obligation.role).
